label: XRN-2010A 32-channel NVR
description: 32-channel 4K NVR with two gigabit RJ45 ports (LAN and WAN), eight internal SATA bays to 48 TB and one eSATA expansion port; no PoE, so cameras need their own switch or injectors.
notes: Hanwha product specifications: 'Ethernet RJ-45 2ea (LAN/WAN, 1Gbps)', 8 SATA bays (0-6 TB each, 48 TB max), 1 eSATA, 256 Mbps recording and 512 Mbps transmission bandwidth. There is no PoE on this model - it is a recorder, not a recorder with a built-in camera switch - and no eSATA port is modelled because it is storage, not a network interface. Protocols include DHCP server and client, which is why both capabilities are declared.
